propositions: The rebar-debug skill closes bug tickets without recording the originating ticket (caused_by link), making defect escape rate unmeasurable.

The automatic blame fallback fails when the fix site is not the cause site (e.g., producer obligation shipped without updating all consumers), incorrectly attributing the defect to old consumer code instead of the introducing change.

The skill must add a required attribution step to Phase 1 Stage 3 that identifies the originating ticket by blaming implicated lines and walking through commits, with explicit --caused-by flag on the bug close.

The attribution step must detect and handle the fix-site-is-not-cause-site case using date tests (implicated lines predating the good-to-bad transition) and producer-side history search to recover the true origin.

Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees using make worktree name=<branch> instead of bare git worktree add, and run commands with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures.
